items.reason: A gentle, active-free cleanser keeps skin comfortable while it recovers.
A ceramide moisturizer supports the look of a smooth, comfortable skin surface.
A mineral SPF 50 helps keep the look of marks from deepening and suits sensitive-feeling skin.

response.routine_note: We removed the 30% peel because strong exfoliating acids are not right for skin within six months of finishing isotretinoin, so please ask your dermatologist or prescriber when resurfacing would be suitable for you. Meanwhile, use the cleanser and moisturizer morning and night and apply the SPF every morning.
